title_en: Hanwha Aerospace: Field Practice 3 Internship Applications, Winter Session 2026
summary: Students in the eligible majors in their third year or above who wish to take the Winter Session 2026 internship course Field Practice 3 (M2177.010700) at Hanwha Aerospace must apply through two channels. They must submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office and also apply on the Hanwha recruitment system. The deadline is 08:00 on Monday, 19 October 2026, and it is strictly enforced.
applies_to: Voluntary; for interested students only. Applicants must meet all of the following: major in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering or the Department of Materials Science and Engineering (added); third year or above, with priority for students expected to graduate in February or August 2027; and a valid official English score, which is mandatory and limited to TOEIC Speaking or OPIc.

dates.what: Application period (department office submission and Hanwha recruitment system application)
dates.when: Wednesday 14 October 2026 to 08:00 on Monday 19 October 2026 (strict deadline)

dates.what: Reference date on which the English score must be valid (document submission deadline)
Announcement of document screening results (candidates for the job interview)
Job interview for students who pass the document screening, held on one day within this period at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul worksite (planned)
dates.when: Wednesday 4 November to Friday 6 November 2026 (one day)

dates.what: Deadline to pay tuition, for finally selected students
Confirmation of background check results and pre-employment medical examination

conditions: You must apply both by submitting documents to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office and on the Hanwha recruitment system; one channel alone is not enough.
The deadline of 08:00 on 19 October 2026 is strictly enforced.
Students taking Field Practice 3 may not take any other course in the winter session.
Any existing registration for other winter session courses will be cancelled.
If you withdraw from the internship partway or do not participate diligently, you will not receive credit and payment of the internship allowance may be restricted.
An official English score is mandatory; only TOEIC Speaking or OPIc is accepted.
Only scores still valid on the document deadline (19 October) are recognised.
Applicants must be in their third year or above; students expected to graduate in February or August 2027 have priority.
Twice the number of places per job will pass the document screening; final selection follows a job interview.
Selected students must pay tuition by 23 November 2026.
Because Hanwha Aerospace is a defence company, a background check is part of the selection process by law.
Selection plans, operation plans and detailed working conditions may change; students who pass the document screening will be told individually of any changes.
Credit recognition differs by department; ask your own department.
steps: Read the three attachments to the original notice (application form, job descriptions to help choose a preferred job, and the Hanwha Aerospace operation plan); their content was not read for this translation.
Complete the application form (Attachment 1: Field Practice 3 participation application form).
Submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office (Building 301, Room 117) by email; the address is in the original notice. Do this by 08:00 on 19 October 2026.
At the same time, apply on the Hanwha recruitment system (Hanwhain) using the job posting link in the notice, by 08:00 on 19 October 2026.
Check the document screening results, expected on 23 October 2026.
If you pass, attend the job interview on one day between 4 and 6 November 2026 at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul worksite.
If finally selected (expected 20 November 2026), pay tuition by 23 November 2026.
Complete the background check confirmation and pre-employment medical examination in December 2026.
Complete the internship from 28 December 2026 to 28 January 2027 (at least 150 hours).
translation:
[Hanwha Aerospace] 2026 Winter Session Internship Semester Programme: Application for the Course 'Field Practice 3' [현장실습 3] (until 08:00 Mon 19 October)

We announce applications for the field practice in the 2026 winter session internship semester course 'Field Practice 3' as follows. Interested students are encouraged to apply.
* In addition to submitting application documents to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office, you must also apply on the Hanwha Aerospace recruitment system.
* You must apply by 08:00 on Monday 19 October 2026; the deadline is strictly enforced.
If you take the internship semester course 'Field Practice 3', you may not take any other course in the seasonal session (any existing registration for other winter session courses will be cancelled).
Also, if you withdraw from the field practice partway or do not participate diligently, no credit will be awarded and payment of the internship allowance may be restricted, so please apply with care.
* Depending on operating circumstances, the internship selection and operation plans and the detailed working conditions may change in part; any changes will be communicated individually to those who pass the document screening.
* Matters such as credit recognition differ by department; please contact your own department.

1. Course: Field Practice 3 (M2177.010700; the responsible professor is named in the original notice)

2. Programme
- Host organisation: Hanwha Aerospace (employment-linked)
- Internship period: 28 December 2026 to 28 January 2027 (at least 150 hours)
- Content: In each assigned department, interns will handle work at the level of a new general (office) employee in each job, carrying out practical, real work.

3. Student requirements
- Major: Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Department of Materials Science and Engineering (added)
- Year: third year or above (priority for students expected to graduate in February or August 2027)
- An official language score is mandatory (TOEIC Speaking or OPIc only). *Only scores valid as of the document deadline (Mon 19 October) are recognised.

4. Planned number of places (twice the number of places per job will be selected at the document stage, with final selection after a job interview)
- Aeronautics Business Division | R&D | Materials | Pangyo | 2–3
- LS Business Division | R&D | Mechanical/Aerospace | Changwon | 2–3
- LS Business Division | R&D | Electrical/Electronic | Changwon | 2–3
- PGM Business Division | R&D | Mechanical/Aerospace | Daejeon | 2–3
- PGM Business Division | R&D | Electrical/Electronic | Daejeon | 2–3
- PGM Business Division | R&D | Software/Computer | Daejeon | 2–3

5. Schedule
- Application: Wed 14 October 2026 to 08:00 Mon 19 October 2026 *strict deadline
 * You must submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office and, at the same time, submit documents on the Hanwha recruitment system.
 * Department of Aerospace Engineering submission: by email (address in the original notice)
 * Hanwhain recruitment system posting link: https://www.hanwhain.com/apply/recruit/detail?rtSeq=19907&hidnKey=AWqcn87wE6WktQ1ZJjas6A1ed5AubeQg1lulcUuj3BM
- Announcement of document screening results (job interview candidates): Fri 23 October 2026 (planned)
- Job interview: one day between Wed 4 November and Fri 6 November 2026 *planned to be held at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul worksite
- Final selection: Fri 20 November 2026 (planned) *Tuition must be paid by Mon 23 November.
- Confirmation of background check results and pre-employment medical examination: in December
 * As a defence company, Hanwha Aerospace includes a background check in the selection process in accordance with the law.

6. Submission and enquiries: Department of Aerospace Engineering office (Building 301, Room 117). The staff contact, email and phone number are in the original notice.
